headerDisplay: Matter-only MQTT measurements. The default outlet remains backward compatible. Native Electrical Meter, Electrical Sensor, Solar Power and Battery Storage types require Homebridge 2.5.0+ and are experimental in Apple Home. Each device remains behind the Matter bridge; standalone publishing is not supported by Homebridge's public API.

id.title: Stable ID (optional)
id.description: Optional stable identity. If omitted, the power MQTT topic is used. Keep this ID unchanged when changing topics.

deviceType.title: Matter device type (experimental)
deviceType.description: outlet preserves previous pairing and Apple Home watt display. Native types need Homebridge 2.5+. Solar Power requires energyExportedTopic; Battery Storage requires batterySocTopic; Electrical Meter requires a cumulative energy topic. Battery Storage also requires batteryCapacityMah.

topic.title: Power topic
topic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing active power.

multiplier.title: Power multiplier
multiplier.description: Multiply the power payload before publishing watts. Use 1000 when the topic is in kW.

voltageTopic.title: Voltage topic (optional)
voltageTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing voltage in V.

voltageMultiplier.title: Voltage multiplier
voltageMultiplier.description: Multiply the voltage payload before publishing volts.

currentTopic.title: Current topic (optional)
currentTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload containing current in A.

currentMultiplier.title: Current multiplier
currentMultiplier.description: Multiply the current payload before publishing amps.

energyImportedTopic.title: Imported/consumed energy topic (optional)
energyImportedTopic.description: Monotonically increasing cumulative energy counter. Do not use a daily counter that resets to zero. For BatteryStorage: charging energy. For solarPower use energyExportedTopic instead.

energyExportedTopic.title: Exported/returned energy topic (optional)
energyExportedTopic.description: Monotonically increasing cumulative returned/exported energy counter. SolarPower requires this for cumulative generation.

batterySocTopic.title: Battery SoC topic (experimental)
batterySocTopic.description: Numeric MQTT payload from 0 to 100 percent. Valid only for default outlet and native batteryStorage; ignored with a warning on electricalMeter/electricalSensor/solarPower. Apple Home battery display/update support is limited.

batteryDcPowerTopic.title: Battery DC power topic (optional)
batteryDcPowerTopic.description: For batteryStorage only. Signed battery DC power in watts, positive = charging, negative = discharging. Unknown if not provided.

batteryCapacityMah.title: Battery rated capacity (mAh, native storage only)
batteryCapacityMah.description: Required when deviceType=batteryStorage. The physical pack's capacity in milliamp-hours (e.g. BYD HVS 12.8 kWh at nominal 512 V: 25000 mAh). Matter requires this value; do not enter kWh here.
